comments.content_routes: Permanent namespace/locale_code/slug reservations belonging to one item.
comments.content_schemas: Semantic versions assembled and sealed atomically before commit.
comments.content_types: Stable Collection identities and the current immutable semantic schema.
comments.enrollment_attempts: Restricted own-account enrollment; completion leaves the account disabled.
comments.enrollment_attempts.password_hash: Pending Argon2id PHC; never used by login before enrollment completion.
comments.enrollment_attempts.pending_ciphertext: AEAD-encrypted TOTP seed; confirmation is required before factors are installed.
comments.function.cms_write_mutex: Acquire the installation write lock before statement row locks.
comments.function.guard_site_child: Сериализует изменения каталога с закрытием снимка и запрещает изменение публикаций.
comments.function.guard_site_revision: Закрывает только полный согласованный каталог и защищает опубликованные версии.
comments.function.guard_site_state: Защищает singleton, последовательность версий и ссылки только на закрытые публикации.
comments.function.lock_languages: Блокирует выбранные языки до конца транзакции публикации без выдачи редактору права менять каталог.
comments.function.ui_placeholders: Извлекает упорядоченные уникальные имена подстановок простого текста.
comments.grant_fields: Exact field identities in a concrete content grant; no implicit future fields.
comments.languages: Каталог языков установки; включение языка разрешается отдельно от импорта метаданных.
comments.languages.code: Нормализованный код языка BCP 47 в нижнем регистре; ключ переводов и маршрутов.
comments.languages.generation: Increments on every enabled toggle; old published locale snapshots stay hidden.
comments.languages.is_enabled: Разрешение публичной выдачи языка; новый язык по умолчанию выключен.
comments.languages.name: Название языка для выбора языка интерфейса.
comments.languages.native_name: Самоназвание языка на его родном языке.
comments.mfa_totp: AEAD-encrypted TOTP enrollment, key version and replay counter; never public.
comments.mfa_totp.last_counter: Highest accepted TOTP time counter; -1 means no accepted code.
comments.onboarding_tokens: Single-use SHA-256 onboarding digests bound to the pending credential version.
comments.onboarding_tokens.consumed_at: Set when enrollment starts or the issuer invalidates an earlier token.
comments.permission_operations: Registered Go operations; migration seeds the exact closed operation set.
comments.recovery_attempts: Recovery reservations ended explicitly under the CMS mutex.
comments.recovery_attempts.pending_ciphertext: AEAD-encrypted replacement TOTP seed confirmed only at completion.
comments.recovery_codes: SHA-256 recovery digests; plaintext codes are returned only once after commit.
comments.role_grants: Exact installation or typed content grants and bounded delegation authority; no future wildcard.

comments.role_grants.type_id: Exact data type or delegation target type; installation-wide authority has no implicit field grants.
comments.roles: Installation-local role identities; role names never authorize an operation.
comments.roles.state: Only active roles grant permissions; restore returns disabled.
comments.security_audit: Append-only bounded security events; immutable identity snapshots without credential data.
comments.security_state: Installation binding and irreversible one-time operator bootstrap marker.
comments.security_state.bootstrap_completed: Never resets when accounts or administrative grants change.
comments.sessions: Opaque session digests; never exposed through public views.
comments.sessions.credential_version: Credential generation at issuance; NULL only for anonymous preauth.
comments.sessions.csrf_digest: SHA-256 digest of a separate CSRF token; never a plaintext bearer.
comments.sessions.expires_at: Absolute expiry; idle touches update last_seen without extending this value.
comments.sessions.kind: Only full sessions authorize CMS; other kinds have restricted allowlists.
comments.sessions.step_up_at: Database time of successful password and TOTP reauthentication.
comments.site_revision_keys: Зафиксированные определения обязательных ключей конкретной версии UI.
comments.site_revision_keys.message_key: Машинный ключ сообщения в этой версии.
comments.site_revision_keys.placeholders: Упорядоченная сигнатура подстановок, зафиксированная при сохранении.
comments.site_revision_languages: Метаданные языков UI, включённых в конкретный снимок.
comments.site_revision_languages.direction: Направление письма ltr или rtl на момент сохранения.
comments.site_revision_languages.language_code: Нормализованный код языка из динамического справочника.
comments.site_revision_languages.name: Название языка на момент сохранения.
comments.site_revision_languages.revision_id: Версия снимка, которой принадлежат зафиксированные метаданные UI-языка.
comments.site_revision_messages: Редакторские сообщения черновика или закрытой версии UI; публичны только текущие.

comments.site_revision_messages.revision_id: Версия снимка, содержащего текст сообщения и его определение ключа.
comments.site_revisions: Типизированный черновик или неизменяемый опубликованный снимок настроек и UI.
comments.site_revisions.accent: Акцент оформления в безопасном формате #RRGGBB, без CSS-выражений.
comments.site_revisions.id: Случайный UUID общей версии настроек и каталога.
comments.site_revisions.notice: Публичное текстовое уведомление, до 2000 символов; пустое скрывает блок.
comments.site_revisions.sealed: Признак проверенного неизменяемого снимка; false означает черновик.
comments.site_revisions.tagline: Публичный краткий девиз установки, до 300 символов.
comments.site_revisions.title: Публичное название установки, от 1 до 200 символов.
comments.site_state: Единственная точка атомарного переключения публикации и контроля конкурирующих команд.
comments.site_state.draft_id: Текущий черновик; NULL после публикации или до первого сохранения.

comments.site_state.singleton: Единственная строка состояния, допустимо только true.

functions.delete_archived_role:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_archived_role(role_id uuid, expected_version bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH deleted AS (
  DELETE FROM public.roles AS r
  WHERE r.id = $1 AND r.version = $2 AND r.state = 'archived'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles AS m WHERE m.role_id = r.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.role_grants AS g WHERE g.role_id = r.id)
  RETURNING r.id
 )
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted);
$function$
functions.guard_security_audit:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_security_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'security audit is append-only' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$
functions.lock_languages:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lock_languages(codes text[])
 RETURNS SETOF public.languages
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT l.* FROM public.languages AS l WHERE l.code = ANY(codes)
 ORDER BY l.code COLLATE "C" FOR SHARE OF l;
$function$
functions.ui_placeholders:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ui_placeholders(value text)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT m[1] ORDER BY m[1]),'{}'::text[])
 FROM regexp_matches(value,'\{([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)\}','g') AS m
$function$

views.public_content_items:
SELECT i.id AS item_id,
    t.key AS type_key,
    t.route_namespace,
    p.schema_no,
    p.id AS publication_id,
    l.locale_code AS language_code,
    l.slug,
    p.published_at,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.key, (p.shared_values -> f.key)) AS jsonb_object_agg
           FROM (public.content_field_definitions d
             JOIN public.content_fields f ON (((d.type_id = f.type_id) AND (d.field_id = f.field_id))))
          WHERE ((d.type_id = p.type_id) AND (d.schema_no = p.schema_no) AND (d.scope = 'shared'::text) AND (d.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (d.kind <> 'relation'::text) AND (p.shared_values ? f.key))), '{}'::jsonb) AS shared_values,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.key, (l.scalar_values -> f.key)) AS jsonb_object_agg
           FROM (public.content_field_definitions d
             JOIN public.content_fields f ON (((d.type_id = f.type_id) AND (d.field_id = f.field_id))))
          WHERE ((d.type_id = p.type_id) AND (d.schema_no = p.schema_no) AND (d.scope = 'localized'::text) AND (d.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (d.kind <> 'relation'::text) AND (l.scalar_values ? f.key))), '{}'::jsonb) AS localized_values,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.key, (p.display_metadata -> f.key)) AS jsonb_object_agg
           FROM (public.content_field_definitions d
             JOIN public.content_fields f ON (((d.type_id = f.type_id) AND (d.field_id = f.field_id))))
          WHERE ((d.type_id = p.type_id) AND (d.schema_no = p.schema_no) AND (d.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (p.display_metadata ? f.key))), '{}'::jsonb) AS display_metadata,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.key, jsonb_build_object('kind', d.kind, 'scope', d.scope, 'config', d.config, 'required', d.required)) AS jsonb_object_agg
           FROM (public.content_field_definitions d
             JOIN public.content_fields f ON (((d.type_id = f.type_id) AND (d.field_id = f.field_id))))
          WHERE ((d.type_id = p.type_id) AND (d.schema_no = p.schema_no) AND (d.visibility = 'public'::text))), '{}'::jsonb) AS field_metadata
   FROM ((((public.content_items i
     JOIN public.content_types t ON ((i.type_id = t.id)))
     JOIN public.content_publications p ON (((i.published_id = p.id) AND (i.id = p.item_id) AND p.sealed)))
     JOIN public.content_publication_locales l ON ((p.id = l.publication_id)))
     JOIN public.languages lang ON (((l.locale_code = lang.code) AND lang.is_enabled AND (l.locale_generation = lang.generation))));
views.public_content_relations:
SELECT visible_source.publication_id,
    visible_source.language_code,
    source_field.key AS field_key,
    visible_target.item_id AS target_item_id,
    visible_target.type_key AS target_type_key,
    visible_target.route_namespace AS target_route_namespace,
    visible_target.slug AS target_slug
   FROM ((((public.public_content_items visible_source
     JOIN public.content_publication_relations link ON (((visible_source.publication_id = link.publication_id) AND ((link.locale_scope = ''::text) OR (visible_source.language_code = link.locale_scope)))))
     JOIN public.content_field_definitions definition ON (((link.type_id = definition.type_id) AND (link.schema_no = definition.schema_no) AND (link.field_id = definition.field_id) AND (definition.visibility = 'public'::text))))
     JOIN public.content_fields source_field ON (((link.type_id = source_field.type_id) AND (link.field_id = source_field.field_id))))
     JOIN public.public_content_items visible_target ON (((link.target_item_id = visible_target.item_id) AND (visible_source.language_code = visible_target.language_code))));
views.public_content_routes:
SELECT r.namespace,
    r.locale_code AS language_code,
    r.slug AS requested_slug,
    r.item_id,
    p.type_key,
    p.slug AS canonical_slug,
    p.publication_id
   FROM (public.content_routes r
     JOIN public.public_content_items p ON (((r.item_id = p.item_id) AND (r.locale_code = p.language_code))));
views.public_languages:
SELECT code,
    name,
    native_name,
    direction
   FROM public.languages
  WHERE is_enabled;
views.public_site:
SELECT r.id,
    r.title,
    r.description,
    r.default_language,
    r.fallback_language,
    r.tagline,
    r.notice,
    r.accent
   FROM (((public.site_state s
     JOIN public.site_revisions r ON (((s.published_id = r.id) AND r.sealed)))
     JOIN public.languages d ON (((r.default_language = d.code) AND d.is_enabled)))
     JOIN public.languages f ON (((r.fallback_language = f.code) AND f.is_enabled)));
views.public_ui_languages:
SELECT c.revision_id,
    c.language_code,
    c.name,
    c.native_name,
    c.direction
   FROM ((public.site_revision_languages c
     JOIN public.public_site s ON ((c.revision_id = s.id)))
     JOIN public.languages l ON (((c.language_code = l.code) AND l.is_enabled)));
views.public_ui_messages:
SELECT m.revision_id,
    m.language_code,
    m.message_key,
    m.message_value
   FROM (public.site_revision_messages m
     JOIN public.public_ui_languages c ON (((m.revision_id = c.revision_id) AND (m.language_code = c.language_code))));
